script: Before you start a video, have three things ready: your notebook, your phone or computer, and about fifteen minutes of quiet time. You do not need to write down every word. Write down only the actions, because actions are what turn learning into income. If a word is new, pause the video and check the glossary at the end of chapter twelve. The videos are short on purpose. A short lesson that you finish is worth more than a long one that you leave half way. Watch, practise, and then move on. In the next video, we look at what digital work really is, and how people get paid for it. Let us begin.
glossary: Canva, WhatsApp Business, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Upwork, Fiverr, LinkedIn, CapCut, Payoneer, OTP, PIN, freelance, Facebook, Instagram
